source.title: Safety Light Corps sediment and Cs sorption dataset
source.publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Office of Research and Development

retrieval.method: Downloaded cation-data.csv and its data dictionary; SHA-256 recorded

transformation.method: Retain public q Cs-133 values and derive Caq and apparent Kd from C0=10 mg/L and 100 g/L solid loading.
limitations: CEC is not reported in this source and therefore the rows cannot satisfy the observation gate.
Ca is not reported; blank competitor fields remain blank rather than being interpreted as zero.
Derived Kd assumes no blank, loss or unmeasured aqueous residual and ideal salt concentration.
The source is a sediment benchmark and is not mixed with Fuller or Dubus materials.

source.title: Ionic strength and pH dependent multi-site sorption of Cs onto a micaceous aquifer sediment

retrieval.method: Downloaded the open-access PDF; retained text-reported points and approximate Fig. 1 marker digitization

transformation.method: Transcribe article values where stated and digitize the remaining Fig. 1 marker centers; derive Kd only where the article does not report it.
limitations: The competing-ion final concentrations were not measured in the source.
Only DIW, Na and K backgrounds are represented; Ca and Mg are absent.
Figure-derived values carry an explicit approximate uncertainty and are not raw observations.
The micaceous sediment is a separate material and is not merged with EPA or Dubus rows.

source.title: Multi-cation exchanges involved in cesium and potassium sorption mechanisms on vermiculite and micaceous structures
source.publisher: Dubus, Prat-Leonhardt and Latrille; Environmental Science and Pollution Research

retrieval.method: Downloaded the HAL full text; digitized selected Fig. 2 marker centers from the published plot

transformation.method: Digitize selected Kd-versus-equilibrium-Cs marker centers from Fig. 2 and attach the reported Ca/Mg/K conditioning values and CEC.
limitations: The values are plot digitizations, not a raw tabular release.
Adsorption and desorption marker semantics are intentionally not inferred for these selected points.
No Na competition series is represented; rights for redistribution of the article are not assumed.
The vermiculite material is a separate benchmark and is not merged with EPA or Fuller rows.
